verdict.rationale: Linear's first-party changelog documents all three parts of the story for initiatives: statuses (including Proposed and Canceled), a Priority field, and the ability to assign a team to lead an initiative. Initiatives are also positioned as a core planning feature. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of initiative tracking, in-depth documentation of the full initiative status lifecycle beyond the changelog snippets.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can track initiatives with status, priority, and an owning team

citations.quote: Proposed and canceled statuses make it clear when an initiative is under consideration or has been intentionally set aside... Priority communicates which initiatives are most important
You can now assign a team to lead an initiative, making it clear who is responsible for driving the work and how it contributes to the broader direction.
Align your team with product initiatives, strategic roadmaps, and clear, up-to-date PRDs.
